answer_1.quote: Standard evaluation protocol in Machine Translation (MT) comprises system tests on a sample of human-translated text.

answer_2.quote: the performance of MT systems is often measured using automatic metrics, the most common of which remains to be the BLEU score.

answer_4.quote: Direct Assessment (DA) HITs were set up and run as in WMT human evaluations on Mechanical Turk but with the distinction of segments being evaluated in the correct order in which they appeared in a document, comprising an initial set of results, which we refer to as segment rating + document context (SR+DC).
answer_4.guideline: translations were rated in a 0-100 scale and quality control was applied.
